    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    cars = image_patch.find("white car")
    buildings = image_patch.find("building")
    
    if not cars or not buildings:
        return []
    
    buildings.sort(key=lambda p: p.horizontal_center)
    left_building = buildings[0]
    
    near_cars = [car for car in cars if distance(car, left_building) < 100]
